device.description: Select the Tuya BLE device to set up. It's better to unbind the device from a Tuya Bluetooth gateway, if any.

login.description:
Optional: the encryption key of the device can be read from the Tuya cloud instead of being entered by hand. Almost all devices only need this once, during setup.

Refer to the documentation of the Tuya integration to retrieve the cloud credentials https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/tuya/

Enter your Tuya credentials.

setup_method.title: Device credentials
setup_method.description: The device is reached over Bluetooth, but its traffic is encrypted with a key that belongs to the device. Enter that key directly, or let it be looked up with a Tuya IoT account.

menu_options.credentials: Enter the device credentials (no Tuya account)
menu_options.login: Look the credentials up in the Tuya cloud

credentials.title: Device credentials
credentials.description:
Enter the credentials of the device at {address}. They are read from the device once and kept in Home Assistant, so no Tuya account and no Bluetooth gateway are used afterwards.

The UUID and product ID are filled in from what the device broadcasts. The device ID and local key cannot be broadcast and have to be supplied: see the integration documentation for ways to read them out.

UUID is 16 characters, device ID is 22 characters, local key is 16 characters.
